verdict.rationale: Trello is a kanban-style project and task management tool. AI-driven breakdown and explanation of code diffs is a code-review capability outside that category. Nothing in the evidence shows Trello ships any diff-review feature; its AI evidence covers only writing or editing card content, which does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
